16 July 2026 𝐂𝐮𝐫𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐀𝐟𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐫𝐬 𝐁𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐛𝐲 𝗔𝗯𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗮𝘃 𝗦𝗮𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗸

1. यास्तिका भाटिया लॉर्ड्स में टेस्ट शतक बनाने और लॉर्ड्स ऑनर्स बोर्ड पर नाम दर्ज कराने वाली पहली भारतीय महिला क्रिकेटर बनीं।
Yastika Bhatia became the first Indian woman cricketer to score a Test century at Lord's and have her name on the Lord's honours board.

2. प्रोजेक्ट 17A के तहत स्वदेश निर्मित उन्नत स्टील्थ फ्रिगेट आईएनएस महेंद्रगिरी को भारतीय नौसेना के पूर्वी बेड़े में शामिल किया गया।
The indigenously built advanced stealth frigate INS Mahendragiri under Project 17A was commissioned into the Indian Navy's Eastern Fleet.

3. प्रख्यात तमिल कवि और गीतकार आर. वैरामुथु को वर्ष 2025 के लिए 60वें ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया।
Eminent Tamil poet and lyricist R. Vairamuthu was honoured with the 60th Jnanpith Award for 2025.

4. दिल्ली सरकार ने 'महिला समृद्धि योजना' का नाम बदलकर 'दिल्ली लक्ष्मी योजना' कर दिया।
The Delhi government renamed the 'Mahila Samriddhi Yojana' as the 'Delhi Laxmi Yojana'.

5. भारत का सबसे बड़ा वैश्विक कपड़ा आयोजन 'भारत टेक्स 2026' नई दिल्ली के भारत मंडपम में शुरू हुआ।
India's largest global textile event, Bharat Tex 2026, commenced at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.

6. प्रसिद्ध पार्श्व गायिका एस. जानकी को 'दक्षिण भारत की कोकिला' के नाम से जाना जाता था।
Legendary playback singer S. Janaki was popularly known as the 'Nightingale of South India'.

7. 8वीं भारत-जापान रक्षा नीति वार्ता 2026 टोक्यो, जापान में आयोजित की गई।
The 8th India-Japan Defence Policy Dialogue 2026 was held in Tokyo, Japan.

8. लॉर्ड्स में इंग्लैंड पर भारत की ऐतिहासिक टेस्ट जीत में क्रांति गौड़ को प्लेयर ऑफ द मैच चुना गया।
Kranti Gaud was named Player of the Match in India's historic Test victory over England at Lord's.

9. चीन के वैज्ञानिकों ने परमाणु अपशिष्ट जल से ट्रिटियम हटाने के लिए NH₂-MIL-101(Cr) मेटल-ऑर्गेनिक फ्रेमवर्क का उपयोग किया।
Chinese scientists used the NH₂-MIL-101(Cr) metal-organic framework to remove tritium from nuclear wastewater.

10. जम्मू-कश्मीर ने रोग निगरानी को मजबूत करने के लिए कुष्ठ रोग को अधिसूचित करने योग्य रोग घोषित किया।
Jammu and Kashmir declared leprosy a notifiable disease to strengthen disease surveillance.

11. भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक ने आंतरिक लोकपाल का तीसरा वार्षिक सम्मेलन मुंबई में आयोजित किया।
The Reserve Bank of India organised the 3rd Annual Conference of Internal Ombudsmen in Mumbai.

12. गुजरात के ऊंझा जीरा और ऊंझा सौंफ को भौगोलिक संकेत (GI) टैग प्राप्त हुआ।
Unjha Cumin and Unjha Fennel of Gujarat received the Geographical Indication (GI) tag.

13. राजस्थान की लगभग 200 साल पुरानी पारंपरिक फुटवियर कला 'जोधपुरी मोजरी' को GI टैग प्रदान किया गया।
Jodhpuri Mojari, a nearly 200-year-old traditional footwear craft of Rajasthan, received the GI tag.

14. सैंड फ्लाई या बालू मक्खी चांदीपुरा वायरस (CHPV) की प्राथमिक वाहक है।
The sand fly is the primary vector of the Chandipura virus (CHPV).

15. नीता अंबानी ने फॉर्च्यून इंडिया मोस्ट पावरफुल वुमन (MPW) 2026 की सूची में शीर्ष स्थान प्राप्त किया।
Nita Ambani secured the top spot in the Fortune India Most Powerful Women (MPW) 2026 list.

Rajaraja I was the first Indian ruler to establish naval supremacy in the Arabian Sea.

3. 'काला झंडा' विरोध का प्रतीक है।
The black flag is a symbol of protest.

4. जर्मेनियम धातु ट्रांजिस्टर में अर्द्धचालक के रूप में प्रयुक्त होती है।
Germanium metal is used as a semiconductor in transistors.

5. प्रधानमंत्री की मृत्यु या त्यागपत्र देने पर मंत्रिमंडल का विघटन हो जाता है।
The Cabinet is dissolved upon the death or resignation of the Prime Minister.

Ultrasound is used to monitor the development of a fetus in the womb.

The foundation of modern education in India was laid by Macaulay’s Minute of 1835.

8. 'केन्द्रीय नमक अनुसंधान संस्थान' भावनगर (गुजरात) में स्थित है।
The Central Salt Research Institute is located in Bhavnagar, Gujarat.

9. पृथ्वी अपने परिक्रमा पथ पर सूर्य के चारों ओर लगभग 30 किलोमीटर प्रति सेकंड की औसत गति से घूमती है।
The Earth revolves around the Sun at an average speed of about 30 km per second.

10. भारत में तुर्की राज्य का वास्तविक संस्थापक कुतुबुद्दीन ऐबक को कहा जाता है।

📌 ACQUISITION OF CITIZENSHIP.

#Citizenship

The Citizenship Act of 1955 prescribes five ways of acquiring citizenship, viz, birth, descent, registration, naturalisation and incorporation of territory: 

🔺️ BY BIRTH

🔸️ A person born in India on or after January 26, 1950 but before July 1, 1987 is a citizen of India by birth irrespective of the nationality of his  parents. 

🔸️ A person born in India on or after July 1, 1987 is considered as a citizen of India only if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ Further, those born in India on or after December 3, 2004 are considered citizens of India only if both of their parents are citizens of  India or one of whose parents is a citizen of India and the other is not an  illegal migrant at the time of their birth.
 
🔸️ The children of foreign diplomats posted in India and enemy aliens  cannot acquire Indian citizenship by birth.

📌 THE CONSTITUTION CONFERS THE FOLLOWING RIGHTS AND PRIVILEGES ON THE CITIZEN OF INDIA (and denies the same to aliens): 

#Citizenship

🔸️ Right to freedom of speech and expression, assembly, association,  movement, residence and profession (Article 19). 

🔸️ Cultural and educational rights (Articles 29 and 30). 

🔸️ Right to vote in elections to the Lok Sabha and state legislative assembly. 

🔸️ Right to contest for the membership of the Parliament and the state legislature. 

🔸️ Eligibility to hold certain public offices, that is, President of India,  Vice-President of India, judges of the Supreme Court and the high courts, Governor of states, Attorney General of India and Advocate General of states.

📌 INTEGRATION OF PRINCELY STATE.

#Unionanditsterritories

🔸️ At the time of independence, India comprised two categories of political units, namely, the British provinces (under the direct rule of British government) and the princely states (under the rule of native princes but subject to the paramountcy of the British Crown). 

🔸️ The Indian Independence Act (1947) created two independent and separate dominions of India and Pakistan and gave three options to the princely states which are :-

• joining India, joining Pakistan or remaining independent. 

🔸️ Of the 552 princely states situated within the geographical boundaries of India, 549 joined India and the remaining 3 (Hyderabad, Junagarh and Kashmir) refused to join India.

🔸️ However, in course of time, they were also integrated with India–Hyderabad by means of police action, Junagarh by means of referendum and Kashmir by the Instrument of Accession.
